note: Coverage groups, not fixed tests, types, files or commit counts. PC3 implements the native prerequisite; another plan alone is not completion.

groups.title: Local PGP and verified committer
groups.obligation: Request local unlock, protect secrets, establish configured signer, preserve agent/environment and verify incremental commits.

groups.title: Current checkout and operator work
groups.obligation: Record current refs/tree/siblings/configuration and dirty/index ownership; reconcile drift without reset.

groups.title: Fresh impact plan
groups.obligation: Actual CodeAnalytics availability/index queries or explicit fallback; add native/API/Razor/DI/asset and new-test blind spots.

groups.title: Positive reproducible regression baseline
groups.obligation: Capture current data-loss counterexample safely and commit repaired-contract tests, not a permanently green loss-of-data oracle.

groups.title: Native dependency boundary
groups.obligation: Reuse existing native model/project edges; light UI/public contracts expose no Application/Persistence/EF or authority services.

groups.title: Single scoped aggregate
groups.obligation: One canonical complete authored definition and revision across five families; no second production dictionary authority.

groups.title: Database uniqueness
groups.obligation: Global and project identity constraints enforced under concurrent first writes, including NULL/case/scope semantics.

groups.title: Canonical additive migration
groups.obligation: Complete composition/AppDbContext registration, append-only migration/snapshot, no unrelated SQL changes or runtime parallel schema.

groups.title: Atomic revision and receipt
groups.obligation: Expected-version CAS and head/publication/receipt commit together; no partial result on a real precommit fault.

groups.title: Idempotent operation identity
groups.obligation: Same ID/payload returns original result across contexts/hosts; changed payload conflict and concurrent duplicate produce one effect.

groups.title: Definition actions are durable
groups.obligation: SaveDraft, Publish, Archive, Delete preserve supported lifecycle/reset meanings and survive a new native scope.

groups.title: Role actions are durable
groups.obligation: Supported role operations, selection identities, template defaults/workflow bindings and all references share the owner.

groups.title: Actual step and hidden fields
groups.obligation: Non-first-step DecisionRoleKey and rich step execution data persist correctly; unrelated fields/steps unchanged.

groups.title: Canvas semantic actions
groups.obligation: All nine reviewed canvas action kinds persist their intended structure/reference/layout meaning into the shared aggregate.

groups.title: Geometry and independent views
groups.obligation: Final coalesced positions survive reload; no pointer-frame write storm, lost move, recreated deleted node or cross-canvas bleed.

groups.title: Materialized imports
groups.obligation: Process/role/artifact content, target, provenance and collision remap are real and atomic; no label-only success or duplicate replay.

groups.title: Truthful catalog and defaults
groups.obligation: Accurate scope/search/count/status/selection, draft plus published presence, bounded queries and non-destructive idempotent FeedDefaults.

groups.title: Complete semantic round trip
groups.obligation: Supported hidden governance/operation/capability/workflow/artifact/child fields survive serialization and command-owned patches.

groups.title: Pinned guidance and resource defaults
groups.obligation: JsonIgnore guidance/materialized role resources preserved with content/provenance; no-op legacy identity/hash compatibility.

groups.title: Native permissions and referential integrity
groups.obligation: Existing policy and typed relationship validation enforced natively; no dangling role/step/branch/artifact references.

groups.title: Accepted result versus stale read
groups.obligation: Both read/commit completion orders preserve known result and exact operation ownership across all families.

groups.title: Authoritative newer observation
groups.obligation: Clean advances and dirty conflicts/reconciles on real newer revision; receipt retained separately; no opaque token ordering or permanent pin.

groups.title: Coherent sibling revision
groups.obligation: Role/step/canvas/import/definition projections agree; stale dirty baseline is not stamped with a newer expected revision.

groups.title: Raw drafts and selected identities
groups.obligation: Retain PC2 role Add/Delete, later selection, row normalization, invalid inputs, discard/refusal and import origin behavior.

groups.title: Unknown and postcommit recovery
groups.obligation: Native durable status resolves unknown and accepted-warning without blind replay; same operation identity survives a new host.

groups.title: Exact opening retirement
groups.obligation: Profile/project lifetime/definition/dispose A-B-A success/error/finally/notification cannot affect a same-public-ID successor.

groups.title: Immutable publication
groups.obligation: Complete validated version with draft coexistence and stable content identity; publish repetition/recovery cannot retarget prior revision.

groups.title: Scope and lifecycle selection
groups.obligation: Explicit project/global/default precedence, named executable source, no hidden archive/missing-data fallback; Delete/reset semantics explicit.

groups.title: Resolved driver source
groups.obligation: Same snapshot in variable preparation/compile; explicitly empty drivers stay empty, no sync-over-async database resolution.

groups.title: Exact executable pipeline
groups.obligation: Kernel, readiness, executor assignments/briefs, current approvals and launch producers consume the same selected content.

groups.title: Prepared launch and republish
groups.obligation: Saved preparation/intent retained through v1-v2 publication changes; current launchability/authority checks never recompile it silently.

groups.title: Pinned child meaning
groups.obligation: Delayed child dispatch uses reviewed immutable child/resources and typed mappings, with existing supported loops and recovery preserved.

groups.title: API and producer compatibility
groups.obligation: Standalone, Workbench, HTTP and agent-tool callers retain request/result/idempotency/link semantics without a legacy bypass.

groups.title: Fresh production scopes and process restart
groups.obligation: All families and publication reread via normal registrations across scopes, browser sessions and a new owned OS-process PID.

groups.title: Populated upgrade preservation
groups.obligation: Pre-PC3 schema upgrade preserves workflows, runtime plans/assignments/prepared admissions and existing recovery; reapply idempotent.

groups.title: Captured mutation admission
groups.obligation: Actual coordinated project/profile guard rejects retirement/recreation or switch; no cross-DB/lifetime state/receipt bleed.

groups.title: Transfer and model coverage
groups.obligation: New facts participate in current transfer residue/lock/schema policy; supported transfer preserved and unsupported cases rejected atomically.

groups.title: Schema validation and rollback truth
groups.obligation: Pending-model/SQL/bootstrap checks plus operating guide; no old-binary mixed-version or lost in-memory draft recovery claim.

groups.title: Production browser J1-J2
groups.obligation: Actual saved/reopened editors, roles/canvas/materialized imports with independent native effect oracles and production lifetimes.

groups.title: Production browser J3-J4
groups.obligation: Two browser contexts conflict/newer revision and genuine native commit/read-back fault recovery; exact one-effect checks.

groups.title: Production browser J5
groups.obligation: Real process restart plus immutable publication/preview/launch behavior and typed native outcome, not only a title or Saved label.

groups.title: Preserved runtime and UI journeys
groups.obligation: J6 affected files, cancel/operator, workflow/Workbench, chat/attachments/voice, context/permissions, graph/chart/Markdown/dialog behavior.

groups.title: Sandbox and delivered assets
groups.obligation: Same complete renderers; source/published Fast/Parity and dependency guards still hold without production native owner services.

groups.title: Measured query and loop effects
groups.obligation: Actual source/fixture/config samples; bounded queries/no N+1, layout writes and startup/compile effects; no fabricated speedup.

groups.title: Final targeted union
groups.obligation: All affected assemblies refreshed; exact discovery/filter/theory counts and reruns for invalidated source; preserved legacy obligations.

groups.title: Frozen broad Stable gate
groups.obligation: Run required final Stable at frozen candidate under current filters; keep browser/live/host lanes separate and failures honest.

groups.title: Portability and artifact safety
groups.obligation: Required helper tests/scan/secret checks; review each baseline change and final enforcement without write-baseline.

groups.title: Current architecture and residual map
groups.obligation: Re-evaluate actual dependency/render closure and native ownership; no artificial next module, untracked required fix or retained production fallback.

groups.title: Source-addressed delivery
groups.obligation: Committed generic tests and sanitized reports with candidate/siblings/config/oracles/evidence; report-only final delta distinguished.

groups.title: Signed incremental completion
groups.obligation: Logical tested commits throughout, each cryptographically verified, no all-at-end batch or automatic push/deployment.
